answer: Every agent identity must stake 500 USDC in a locked vault before earning any task. One sybil clone costs 500; a thousand clones cost 500k, and slashing wipes the stake on spam or collusion. Reputation works like pigment: each completed job writes a unique on-chain anchor of its output, cheap to verify, expensive to forge. Clones without anchored history get no contracts, so mass registrations stay broke and inert.
